Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00

; Rockstar Games — Per-game keys
; Real export: HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Rockstar Games\{gameName}\InstallFolder

[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Rockstar Games\Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced]
"InstallFolder"=str(2):"PLACEHOLDER_ROCKSTAR_BASE/Games/Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced"
"GTAV"=str(2):"PLACEHOLDER_ROCKSTAR_BASE/Games/Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced/GTAV.exe"
"GTAVLauncher"=str(2):"PLACEHOLDER_ROCKSTAR_BASE/Games/Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced/GTAVLauncher.exe"
"Launcher"=str(2):"C:\\Program Files\\Rockstar Games\\Launcher\\Launcher.exe"

; Rockstar Launcher — launcher path only
[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Rockstar Games\Launcher]
"InstallFolder"=str(2):"C:\\Program Files\\Rockstar Games\\Launcher\\"
